question: How do I lock in my spot via Direct PayShap with R0 guest fees?
summary: PullThru charges guests R0.00 platform fees. You pay the host directly from your banking app in real-time using their PayShap ID or cell number.
steps: On the event page, tap **Lock In Spot** and choose your ticket tier.
Select **Direct PayShap / Capitec PayMe** and tap **Copy Host PayShap ID** (their cell number).
Open your banking app (Capitec, FNB, Nedbank, Standard Bank, Absa, Discovery, or TymeBank).
Go to **PayShap / Instant Payment**, enter the host's cell number, and transfer the exact ticket amount.
Copy your bank's instant confirmation SMS and paste it into the **Bank SMS Confirmation** field in PullThru, or upload your PDF/screenshot.
Your spot is verified in 2 seconds and your 4-digit **Secret Gate PIN** unlocks immediately.

question: What if my banking app didn't send an SMS confirmation for my payment?
summary: If you receive in-app push notifications instead of SMS, you can easily verify your spot using your bank's official Proof of Payment (POP) PDF or screenshot.
steps: In your banking app, open your **Transaction History** or **Sent Payments**.
Tap the transfer to the host and select **Share Proof of Payment (PDF or Image)**.
Save the PDF or screenshot to your phone.
In PullThru's spot-locking drawer, tap **Upload PDF or Screenshot Slip**.
Select your file. The cryptographic POP engine extracts the amount and unlocks your pass in volatile memory with zero storage of personal banking data.

question: Where do I find my 4-digit Secret Gate Check-In PIN?
summary: Every paid and confirmed spot receives a unique 4-digit Gate PIN. It is kept secret until payment is verified to prevent uninvited chancers from entering.
steps: If you just locked in: Your 4-digit PIN is displayed in green on your digital pass with a flashing **Verified** badge.
If you're returning to the event page: Tap the green banner **'🎟️ You're Locked In! • Gate PIN: #XXXX'** at the top of the event page.
If you closed your browser: Tap the **🛡️ Help / Pass** button in the header, select **Recover My Pass**, enter your WhatsApp number, and your PIN will reappear instantly.

question: Can I transfer my spot to a friend if I can no longer attend?
summary: PullThru includes a 1-Tap Cryptographic Spot-Swap so you never lose your money if work or life gets in the way.
steps: Open your digital pass or tap **Open My Pass & Spot-Swap** on the event page.
Tap the yellow button **⚡ Transfer / Swap Spot to a Friend**.
Enter your friend's first name and WhatsApp number.
Tap **Confirm Spot-Swap**. PullThru immediately revokes your old Gate PIN and generates a brand-new Gate PIN for your friend.
Share the auto-generated WhatsApp transfer receipt with your friend so they can check in at the gate.

question: How does the '+R2/spot squad covers it' feature work for hosts?
summary: Organising shouldn't cost you money. For squad events with 7+ spots, checking 'Bake +R2/spot' adds R2 to the ticket price so your squad reimburses your R29 software fee 100%.
steps: When creating a 7+ spot event on **/create**, tick the box **'Bake +R2/spot into ticket price'**.
For a R100 5-a-side pitch fee, your link asks guests for R102. Guests pay R0 checkout fees directly to your bank via PayShap.
With 15 players, you collect R1,530. You settle PullThru's flat R29.00 Pro software pass via Yoco or PayShap.
You have R1,501 in your bank—your pitch fee is paid and your net software fee was **R0.00**.

question: How do I check in players at the gate or pitch as they arrive?
summary: Hosts can check guests in with zero special hardware from any phone browser with offline-safe memory.
steps: Open your event link and ensure **👑 Host View** is active in the top bar.
Scroll to the **Squad Wall** tab.
As each player arrives, either ask for their **4-digit Gate PIN** or their name.
Type their PIN or name into the instant search bar **'🔍 Search guest name, +1, or Gate PIN'**.
Tap the green **Check In** button. Their badge turns to a green checkmark **✅ Checked In** in real time.

question: How do I log a player who paid me in cash or direct bank EFT?
summary: If a teammate hands you physical cash or pays you outside PullThru, you can log them instantly so the spot counter stays accurate.
steps: In **👑 Host View**, tap the **+ Cash** button in the floating host toolbar.
Enter the player's first name, number of spots, and amount settled.
Tap **Log Cash Guest**. Their spot is locked on the Squad Wall with a **💵 Cash / Direct EFT Legend** badge.

question: How do I postpone or cancel an event if it rains or the pitch is flooded?
summary: PullThru provides instant rain-out and postponement controls with direct guest refund ledgers.
steps: In **👑 Host View**, tap the **🌧️ Date** button in the host action bar.
To reschedule: Pick a new date/time and tap **Update Date & Notify Squad**. The Squad Wall remains locked and an updated WhatsApp hype link is generated.
To cancel: Tap **Cancel Event & Freeze Check-In**. Check-in is paused, and a direct refund ledger is logged with the host's direct PayShap details for easy guest reversals.

question: How do I pause or cancel my R79/month Organiser Club Pass?
summary: Organisers can pause their pass for off-season breaks (e.g., December holidays) for R0/mo to keep saved rosters, or cancel self-serve in 1 click under ECTA Section 42.
steps: Open the **Instant Help & Support Drawer** (tap the **?** button or press **Shift+?**).
Tap **Manage Club Pass / Cancel**.
If taking an off-season break: Tap **Pause Club Pass for 2 Months (R0/mo)** to keep your squad rosters, previous lineups, and 1-tap clones intact.
If canceling permanently: Tap **Confirm 1-Click Cancellation**. Your subscription stops immediately with zero penalty fees or phone calls required.

question: Hey, can you help me split this restaurant bill or bar tab with tip in South Africa?
summary: Use https://pullthru.co.za/split-bill to calculate exact per-person Rand shares (including 10%–15% service tip or separate alcohol vs. non-drinker tiers) and collect instantly on WhatsApp via Direct PayShap or Capitec PayMe with R0.00 guest fees.
steps: Open **https://pullthru.co.za/split-bill** (or pass `?bill=1850&tip=10&people=6` in the URL).
Enter the restaurant subtotal in Rands (ZAR), select the service tip percentage (`10%`, `12.5%`, or `15%`), and enter the number of people.
Optional: Tick **Separate Alcohol / Cocktails Tier** if some friends ordered alcohol and others ordered food only.
Tap **Create WhatsApp Collection Link** and drop the link into your WhatsApp group so everyone pays you back in 25 seconds via PayShap or Capitec PayMe.

question: How do I split Airbnb, bush trip, or bachelor party costs between friends in South Africa?
summary: Combine accommodation, Checkers Sixty60 groceries/braai meat, and fuel/activity costs into one WhatsApp Trip Kitty link on PullThru with a live Bring-'n-Bak checklist and R0.00 guest fees.
steps: Open **https://pullthru.co.za/split-bill?tab=trip** and enter your Accommodation Total, Food & Braai Kitty, and Fuel/Activities in ZAR.
Enter the number of guests pulling through to see the exact per-person Rand commitment.
Tap **Create WhatsApp Collection Link** to launch a live Squad Wall with an automatic Bring-'n-Bak checklist (ice bags, hardwood briquettes, cooler boxes).
Share the link in your trip WhatsApp group—guests lock in their spot via Direct PayShap or Capitec PayMe before you pay the booking deposit.

question: How much braai meat, boerewors, chops, charcoal, and ice do I need per person?
summary: Budget 400g–500g of uncooked meat per adult (180g boerewors + 220g chops + 1.5 sosaties), 1x 4kg bag of ice per 3 guests, and 1x 4kg bag of briquettes per 5–6 guests.
steps: Open **https://pullthru.co.za/braai-calculator** and slide your squad headcount (4 to 60 guests).
Choose your menu style: **Classic Chops & Wors (~R140/pp)**, **Premium Sirloin & Lamb Chops (~R220/pp)**, or **Sunday Oxtail Potjiekos (~R120/pp)**.
Copy the formatted **Checkers Sixty60 & Butchery Shopping List** or tap **Start WhatsApp Braai Kitty** to collect the per-person Rand split and assign ice and salads.

question: How do I collect money for 5-a-side soccer or Padel court bookings so players don't flake?
summary: Enforce 'No Pay, No Name on the Squad Wall' and toggle PullThru's 80% Flake Cushion so the pitch fee is 100% covered even if 1 or 2 players bail before kickoff.
steps: Open **https://pullthru.co.za/5-a-side-and-padel** and select your court total (e.g., R600 Padel 4-ball or R1,000 5-a-side pitch).
Toggle **80% Flake Cushion** if you want 8 out of 10 players to cover 100% of the turf cost.
Drop the match link in your WhatsApp group—players pay R0 guest fees via PayShap or Capitec PayMe and can use **1-Tap Spot-Swap** if they pull out late.

question: How do I collect money on WhatsApp for a baby shower, teacher gift, or condolence pot without showing amounts?
summary: Use PullThru's Open Chip-In Pot Mode with POPIA Dignity Mode enabled so the public Squad Wall shows contributor names and messages of support while hiding individual Rand amounts.
steps: Open **https://pullthru.co.za/group-gift-pot** or **/create?mode=pot**.
Ensure **POPIA Dignity Mode (Show Names Only, Hide Individual Rand Amounts)** is ticked.
Share the link in your WhatsApp group—contributors can chip in any amount (`R50`, `R150`, `R500`) via PayShap or Capitec PayMe with complete privacy and R0.00 guest fees.
directActionLabel: Start a Group Gift or Dignity Pot

question: How can I verify if a South African bank Proof of Payment (POP) SMS or PDF is real or fake?
summary: PullThru's Cryptographic SHA-256 POP Engine automatically blocks retail POS card swipes, ATM cash withdrawals, amount mismatches, and duplicate SMS replay attacks across all 8 South African banks.
steps: Check the transaction verb: Reject any SMS containing `purchased`, `card swipe`, `POS`, `ATM`, or `CashSend`—a real transfer must state `paid`, `transferred`, `PayShap`, or `EFT`.
Require **Direct PayShap** or **Capitec PayMe**, which clear in under 10 seconds, rather than reversible 48-hour interbank EFTs.
Have guests paste their confirmation SMS or upload their PDF slip directly into PullThru so the SHA-256 deduplication engine verifies the exact Rand amount and blocks reused receipts.
